{{Current events|year=2019|month=09|day=7|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)]], [[Afghan peace process]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] says he has "called off" peace negotiations with the [[Taliban]] over [[September 2019 Kabul bombings|the latest Taliban attack]] in [[Kabul]]. It is not clear if the talks are paused or altogether cancelled. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/trump-called-peace-talks-taliban-attack-190908014028311.html (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-mckenzie/spike-in-taliban-attacks-unhelpful-to-afghan-peace-push-u-s-general-idUSKCN1VS0MX (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Joi Ito|Joichi Ito]] steps down as the director of the [[MIT Media Lab]] and as a member of the board of directors of [[The New York Times Company]]. Yesterday, ''[[The New Yorker]]'' wrote that the lab hid its financial links with [[Jeffrey Epstein]] after Epstein had pleaded guilty of procuring a minor for prostitution in 2008. [https://www.npr.org/2019/09/07/758670699/m-i-t-media-lab-director-steps-down-over-financial-ties-to-jeffrey-epstein (NPR)]
*[[Mastercard]] cuts access to two Venezuelan banks. [https://venezuelanalysis.com/news/14649 (Venezuelanalysis)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[2019 Pacific typhoon season#Typhoon Lingling (Liwayway)|Typhoon Lingling]] impacts [[South Korea]], killing at least three people and knocking out power to over 50,000 homes, according to the [[Ministry of the Interior and Safety (South Korea)|Ministry of the Interior and Safety]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/09/person-killed-powerful-typhoon-slams-south-korea-190907085411587.html (Al Jazeera)]

;International relations
*[[Russia–Ukraine relations]], [[Ukrainian crisis]]
**[[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] swap prisoners on a "35-to-35" basis, including [[Oleg Sentsov]], [[Mykola Karpyuk]], [[Olexandr Kolchenko]], [[Roman Sushchenko]], and 24 [[Ukrainian Navy]] sailors detained by Russia during the 2018 [[Kerch Strait incident]]. The exchange includes [[Kirill Vyshinsky]]. The [[Cabinet of the Netherlands#Incumbent Cabinet|Dutch government]] says it "seriously regrets" that [[Malaysia Airlines Flight 17#Criminal_prosecution|Volodymyr Tsemakh]] is included in the swap. [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] lauds the move as "perhaps a first giant step to peace." [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-russia-prisoners/russia-and-ukraine-swap-prisoners-in-first-sign-of-thawing-relations-idUSKCN1VS04X (Reuters)] [https://www.pravda.com.ua/rus/news/2019/09/7/7225601/ (Ukrayinska Pravda)] [https://www.pravda.com.ua/rus/news/2019/09/7/7225603/ (Ukrayinska Pravda)] [https://tass.com/politics/1077066 (TASS)]
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**The [[Atomic Energy Organization of Iran]] announces it has activated the research and development of new [[uranium enrichment]] centrifuges. It is the third breach of the 2015 [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]] agreement from which the [[United States]] [[United States withdrawal from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action|withdrew]] last year, [[United States sanctions against Iran#Post-JCPOA_sanctions|reimposing U.S. sanctions on Iran]]. [[President of Iran|Iranian President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] has recently stated his country will reimplement the agreement only if the remaining parties also do so, giving them two extra months. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-ramps-up-uranium-enrichment-in-latest-nuclear-breach/a-50336501 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[Colombia–Venezuela relations]]
**Venezuelan president [[Nicolás Maduro]] has the Venezuelan military deploy air defense missiles to its border with [[Colombia]] after declaring an "orange alert" signifying potential or likely incoming threat. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/venezuela-deploys-air-defense-missiles-colombian-border-to-ward-off-potential-attack/ (Al Masdar)]

;Law and crime
*The Venezuelan ''de facto'' Attorney General [[Tarek William Saab]] announces a charge of [[high treason]] against acting president [[Juan Guaidó]]. This comes as part of an investigation where the Maduro government alleges Guaidó does not support the Venezuelan claim to the [[Guayana Esequiba]] region, despite Guaidó having been a vocal supporter of the claim since he entered politics in 2007. [https://www.scmp.com/news/world/americas/article/3026156/venezuelan-prosecutors-charge-opposition-leader-juan-guaido (South China Morning Post)], [https://news.yahoo.com/venezuela-prosecutors-charge-guaido-high-treason-185544663.html (Yahoo)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Secretary of State for Work and Pensions]] [[Amber Rudd]] resigns from [[Boris Johnson|Boris Johnson's]] [[Johnson ministry|cabinet]] and the [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative]] whip in protest of both his handling of Brexit and his expulsion of 21 MPs from the party. Rudd will now sit as an [[Independent politician#Independent_and_undescribed_candidates|independent MP]] in the [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/07/uk/uk-amber-rudd-resigns-parliament-gbr-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Salman of Saudi Arabia|King Salman of Saudi Arabia]] replaces [[Ministry of Energy (Saudi Arabia)|Minister of Energy]] [[Khalid A. Al-Falih|Khalid al-Falih]] with his son [[Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud|Abdulaziz bin Salman]] by [[Decree#Saudi_Arabia|royal order]]. Earlier this month, al-Falih was replaced with [[Yasir Al-Rumayyan]], head of the [[Public Investment Fund of Saudi Arabia|kingdom’s sovereign wealth fund]] and a close adviser to the [[Mohammed bin Salman|crown prince]], as chairman of [[Saudi Aramco]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2019-09-07/saudi-replaces-energy-minister-al-falih-with-an-mbs-brother (Bloomberg)]
*[[2019 Venezuelan presidential crisis]]
**[[Juan Guaidó]] appoints [[Leopoldo Lopez]] to form a [[shadow cabinet]] in preparation for taking control of the Venezuelan government. Lopez is currently in refuge in the Spanish embassy of Venezuelan capital [[Caracas]] after being freed from house arrest by dissident military during the 30 April uprising, which may have removed a bar placed on him from engaging in political activity. [https://www.voanews.com/americas/guaido-ally-under-spanish-protection-forming-shadow-venezuelan-cabinet (VOA)]
